scripts.check: concurrently --group --names biome,tsc,test,web,rust,fallow --prefix-colors auto "bun run check:biome" "bun run check:tsc" "bun run check:test" "bun run check:web" "bun run check:rust" "bun run check:fallow"
scripts.check:fix: concurrently --group --names biome,rust --prefix-colors auto "biome check --write" "bun run --filter '*' fix:rust"
